name: Discriminant Analysis
when_to_use: Known, labeled groups; categorical dependent variable, metric predictors; classify new cases from the characteristics that best separate the groups.
notes: Uses known characteristics of already classified groups to predict which group a new case belongs to. Applications: classify customers as "high risk"/"low risk" for credit.

expected_input.question: Which known group does a new case most likely belong to?

plain_explanation.purpose: Creates a rule that separates already known groups using numeric measures.
plain_explanation.when_to_use_plain: When you want to classify new cases into existing groups and see what most differentiates the groups.
plain_explanation.data_needed: Numeric columns and a column with the known group.
plain_explanation.example: Distinguish good and bad payers by income, age and debts.
plain_explanation.diagram: two groups of points -> line that best separates them
